title: CQRS Command Specification Schema
description: Schema for individual CQRS Command (Write/Mutation surface) definition files in commands/*.command.yaml.

id.description: Unique dotted identifier of the command (e.g. faktury.scan.upload).

name.description: Short human-readable title of this command.

payload_schema.description: Expected request body fields, formats, and validation constraints.

description.description: Detailed explanation of what mutation or transaction is executed.

idempotency.description: Deduplication and idempotency guarantees on repeated executions.

side_effects.description: Files, records, or external state mutated by this command.

ui_trigger.description: Which UI button, form submission or gesture triggers this command.

process_uri.description: Optional underlying Dockuri or mesh process URI backing this command.

emitted_urns.description: Canonical RFC 8141 URNs assigned to artifacts or transactions created.
